about: What tools/build_latest.ps1 builds: the newest playable state. The orchestrator keeps this current as branches land; every listed merge is checked to be conflict-free when it changes. Branch names are without origin/; paths are relative to unity/.
contents: The farmland preview at physics model 85, now with Play and the map: the menu's Play opens a carousel of two maps, House (the test range, back in the game with its car, fence and houses) and Village (the friend's farmland, from the village start point), each card with a still through the analog feed and the OSD; the setup, the flight, R and Fly again stay on the chosen map, and the summary names it. M opens a map of the whole world in flight and in Explore, centred and smaller than the window, with the drone's position and heading live, and nothing pauses while it shows. Explore's OSD shows the throttle again, from the radio's stick. Village as before: its hills, and its trees, bushes and ruins solid (1,679 objects); the drawn ground near the drone matches the physics to 0.1 mm (D-099); laid fiber lies over crests, wraps the ledge's lip, and freezes into the trail where it rests instead of sliding at turns (W3 2.4); the wind follows the hills (faster over crests, sheltered in the lee, separated below the ledge) and takes every point's own ground (W7); a drone flying into a tree crown cuts twigs at their real cost to the props and drops out, and thin ruin walls stop it like solid ones (W3 2.7); a crash creates no energy (W3 2.6); tree trunks and limbs no longer flutter with the leaves; the friend's look (soft shadows, SSAO, the haze), with the frame rate tuned for the feed: 111 fps through the feed in the laptop's Performance mode (W6), about 60 fps in Quiet mode, where the GPU is held at 20 W; Explore opens Village in noclip; plus everything before: the analog feed, OSD, legs that set, crack and break, props, motors, the fiber's contacts, the failsafe, R, C, X, V, pause, the summary and the flight log. Known: straw, grass and leaves don't act on the props yet, and some cut landings on 10 to 20 degree slopes tumble from a contact bug (both are the Village physics work: audited and planned, not built yet); the open map covers the OSD's centre; on House's map the houses are only about 10 px across; at a sharp low turn the spool's peel still drags the last laid corner in by metres (a question for the pilot); a pine's thick arms are needle cards and still flutter; our trenches, houses and cars are not in Village yet (W5).
